name: tableflow
description: A local-only HTML table helper for Microsoft Edge and Chromium.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node scripts/check-privacy.mjs && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode auto-icons && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode background && node scripts/finalize-dist.mjs && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.release:final: node scripts/check-manual-qa.mjs && npm run release:check && node scripts/package.mjs --final
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:tools && node scripts/run-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:components: npm run build && npm run build:tools && node scripts/run-e2e.mjs components component-performance
scripts.verify: node scripts/check-version.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm --prefix tests/component-lab run typecheck && npm run lint && node scripts/check-test-policy.mjs && npm test -- --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile=.test-artifacts/unit-results.json && npm run test:e2e && npm run build && node scripts/write-compatibility-report.mjs && node scripts/write-real-report.mjs
